'''Plunder Moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], located in the [[Plunder Moon system/Legends|Plunder Moon system]] within the [[Black Hole sector]]. A [[Unidentified Star Temple|Star Temple]] was located on the moon.
